title: The fixed-true component of ordinary inverse-exchange trace transport.
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, N a natural number annihilating A, t normalized finite twist transport, S a scheme with N invertible in global sections, and f:X→S proper with i:X ≅ ProjectiveLine(S) satisfying i.hom ≫ q = f. For any morphism τ:Rq* A_P(1)[2] → A_S, the displayed ordinary inverse-exchange transport equation holds for the fixed projection a = true. This is the second component of the arbitrary-trace transport and has no splitting family, chart trace, trace base-change hypothesis, supported class or diagonal integral.

source.place: The paragraphs identifying t_p1 and t_p2 with base change of t_q, using qp1=qp2 and the composite-adjunction counit.

proof.text: Transport both sides of the fixed-true interface along the proved equality of the Boolean second-projection shriek functor and the explicit second-projection shriek functor, then cancel that isomorphism component. Apply the generic categorical pasting calculation to the entire presentationExchange family before specializing its coefficient object to the shifted line on ProjectiveLine S. This separates the inverse-image square comparison from the supported self-product exchange, forget-supports, direct-image composition, and cancellation along i.

Use coordinateLineComparison to identify the coefficient correction and inverse first-projection square comparison with the coordinate correction followed by pullback of the inverse line comparison along i. Its proof establishes normalized shifted-line composition, including N=0, directly from uniqueness.

Use ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback_comp and constantUnit_pullback for unit_transport. The latter is proved from the existing cached right-unit compatibility by faithful tensor cancellation, after normalizing the actual constant object. The generic naturality-pasting lemma carries the arbitrary tau across the exchange isomorphisms. The shared trace construction is factored through presentationTrace; its proved associativity equation identifies this construction with the original recorded direct-image formula.

proof_origin.place: Coefficient-square normalization, monoidal unit compatibility, and a generic naturality-pasting calculation, with the coefficient-independent geometric exchange isolated as presentationExchange.

lean.statement:
theorem projectionTraceTransport_true
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0) (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f]
    (i : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S) (hi : i.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) = f)
    (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (τ : ordinaryFiniteP1SplittingTarget A N hA S ⟶ ordinaryFiniteUnit A S) :
    middleComparison A N hA t f i hi hS true ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).map (projectionExchange A N hA t S hS true) ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).map
          ((ordinaryFinitePullback A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).map τ ≫
            (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).hom) ≫
        (constantComparison A i).hom =
      coordinateTrace A N hA t f i hi hS τ true
